body:
Prompt injection risk: lib/gemini.js generateAnswers embeds untrusted job description text and custom questions into the prompt (JSON-serialized but still model-readable). A malicious job page/custom question can include instructions (e.g., “ignore previous instructions”) that may steer the model’s output despite the non-deterministic systemInstruction mitigation, leading to manipulated application answers. --- To fix this without changing core functionality, keep using job description/custom questions as factual source material but **neutralize high-risk instruction-like patterns before prompt inclusion**. The best targeted fix in lib/gemini.js is:

  • Add a small sanitizer that redacts common prompt-injection phrases and role/control tokens from untrusted strings.
  • Apply it to jd and each customQuestions entry before jsonData(...).
  • Keep existing system instruction and JSON framing intact.

    • This preserves behavior (still uses JD/questions for facts) while reducing the chance that hostile imperative text can steer the model.
    Edits are localized to generateAnswers region (around lines 334–352) plus helper function definitions nearby in the same file. No external dependency is required.
